SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PROJ_ID AS id, NULL AS parentId, 'PROJECT' AS type, P.PROJ_NM AS title, SUBSTR(P.PROJ_CN, 1, 200) AS summary, P.PROJ_STAT_CD AS statusCode, LDR.EMP_NM AS managerName, P.PROJ_PRGRS_RT AS progress, P.PROJ_BGNG_YMD AS projectStartDateText, P.PROJ_END_YMD AS projectEndDateText, NULL AS projectName, NULL AS priorityCode, NULL AS dueDate, NULL AS startDateTime, NULL AS endDateTime, NULL AS allDay, NULL AS writerName, NULL AS classificationCode, NULL AS hostName, NULL AS participantCount, NULL AS meetingOnline, NULL AS meetingTypeCode, NULL AS educationStartDate, NULL AS senderName, NULL AS senderAddress, NULL AS receivedAt, NULL AS mailRead, NULL AS hasAttachment, NULL AS bodyPreview FROM TB_PROJECT P INNER JOIN TB_PROJ_MEMBER PM ON PM.PROJ_ID = P.PROJ_ID AND PM.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND PM.LEAVE_DT IS NULL INNER JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE LDR ON LDR.EMP_ID = P.PROJ_LDR_EMP_ID WHERE UPPER(P.PROJ_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT T.TASK_ID, T.PROJ_ID, 'TASK', T.TASK_NM, SUBSTR(T.TASK_CN, 1, 200), T.TASK_STAT_CD, MNGR.EMP_NM, NULL, NULL, NULL, P.PROJ_NM, T.TASK_PRIORITY_CD, T.TASK_END_DT, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM TB_TASK T INNER JOIN TB_TASK_PTCPT TP ON TP.TASK_ID = T.TASK_ID AND TP.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND TP.LEAVE_DT IS NULL INNER JOIN TB_PROJECT P ON P.PROJ_ID = T.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE MNGR ON MNGR.EMP_ID = T.TASK_MNGR_ID WHERE T.DEL_YN = 'N' AND UPPER(T.TASK_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT S.SCHD_ID, NULL, 'SCHEDULE', S.SCHD_NM, SUBSTR(S.SCHD_DETAIL_CN, 1, 200), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, S.BEGIN_DT, S.END_DT, CASE WHEN S.ALL_DAY_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, WRTR.EMP_NM, S.SCHD_CLSF_CD, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM TB_INTG_SCHD S INNER JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE WRTR ON WRTR.EMP_ID = S.SCHD_WRTR_ID WHERE S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND UPPER(S.SCHD_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND ( S.SCHD_WRTR_ID = #{empId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SCHD_TARGET ST WHERE ST.SCHD_ID = S.SCHD_ID AND ( ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '01' OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '02' AND ST.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{empId})) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '03' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_EMPLOYEE CE WHERE CE.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND CE.EXEC_YN = 'Y' )) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '04' AND ST.TARGET_ID = ( SELECT CE.DEPT_CD FROM TB_EMPLOYEE CE WHERE CE.EMP_ID = #{empId} )) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '05' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROJ_MEMBER PM2 WHERE TO_CHAR(PM2.PROJ_ID) = ST.TARGET_ID AND PM2.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND PM2.LEAVE_DT IS NULL )) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '06' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TASK_PTCPT TP2 WHERE TO_CHAR(TP2.TASK_ID) = ST.TARGET_ID AND TP2.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND TP2.LEAVE_DT IS NULL )) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '07' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MTNG_PTCPT MP2 WHERE TO_CHAR(MP2.MTNG_ID) = ST.TARGET_ID AND MP2.EMP_ID = #{empId} )) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '08' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV CR WHERE TO_CHAR(CR.RSRV_ID) = ST.TARGET_ID AND CR.RSRV_EMP_ID = #{empId} )) ) ) )
UNION ALL
SELECT M.MTNG_ID, NULL, 'MEETING', M.MTNG_NM, NULL, CASE WHEN M.BEGIN_DT > SYSDATE THEN 'SCHEDULED' WHEN M.END_DT < SYSDATE THEN 'ENDED' ELSE 'LIVE' END, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, M.BEGIN_DT, M.END_DT, NULL, NULL, NULL, HOST.EMP_NM, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MTNG_PTCPT PC WHERE PC.MTNG_ID = M.MTNG_ID), CASE WHEN M.MTNG_TYPE_CD IN ('01', '03') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, M.MTNG_TYPE_CD, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM TB_MTNG M INNER JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE HOST ON HOST.EMP_ID = M.CRTR_ID WHERE M.DEL_YN = 'N' AND UPPER(M.MTNG_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND ( M.CRTR_ID = #{empId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MTNG_PTCPT MP WHERE MP.MTNG_ID = M.MTNG_ID AND MP.EMP_ID = #{empId} ) )
UNION ALL
SELECT E.EDU_ID, NULL, 'EDUCATION', E.EDU_NM, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, E.EDU_BEGIN_YMD, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM TB_EDU_MGMT E INNER JOIN TB_EDU_ATND_RLTM EA ON EA.EDU_ID = E.EDU_ID AND EA.EMP_ID = #{empId} WHERE UPPER(E.EDU_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT MM.MAIL_MSG_ID, NULL, 'MAIL', MM.MAIL_SJ, SUBSTR(MM.SNIPPET, 1, 200), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, CASE WHEN INSTR(MM.FROM_EMAIL, '<') > 0 THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(MM.FROM_EMAIL, 1, INSTR(MM.FROM_EMAIL, '<') - 1)) ELSE MM.FROM_EMAIL END, CASE WHEN INSTR(MM.FROM_EMAIL, '<') > 0 THEN SUBSTR( MM.FROM_EMAIL, INSTR(MM.FROM_EMAIL, '<') + 1, INSTR(MM.FROM_EMAIL, '>') - INSTR(MM.FROM_EMAIL, '<') - 1 ) ELSE MM.FROM_EMAIL END, COALESCE(MM.INTERNAL_DATE, MM.MAIL_SNDNG_DT), CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_LABEL_MAP LM INNER JOIN TB_MAIL_LABEL L ON L.MAIL_LABEL_ID = LM.MAIL_LABEL_ID WHERE LM.EMP_ID = MM.EMP_ID AND LM.MAIL_MSG_ID = MM.MAIL_MSG_ID AND TRIM(L.LABEL_TYPE_CD) = 'UNREAD' ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MAIL_ATTACHMENT MA WHERE MA.EMP_ID = MM.EMP_ID AND MA.MAIL_MSG_ID = MM.MAIL_MSG_ID ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, SUBSTR(MM.SNIPPET, 1, 500) FROM TB_MAIL_MESSAGE MM WHERE MM.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND MM.DEL_YN = 'N' AND MM.DRAFT_YN = 'N' AND ( UPPER(MM.MAIL_SJ) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(MM.SNIPPET) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(MM.FROM_EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ) ) ORDER BY type, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SEARCH_HIST (SEARCH_HIST_ID, EMP_ID, KEYWORD, REG_DT) VALUES (SEQ_SEARCH_HIST.NEXTVAL, #{empId}, #{keyword}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT search_hist_id, emp_id, keyword, reg_dt FROM TB_SEARCH_HIST WHERE emp_id = #{empId} ORDER BY reg_dt DESC
SELECT recent_item_id, emp_id, item_type, item_id, accessed_dt FROM TB_RECENT_ITEM WHERE emp_id = #{empId} ORDER BY accessed_dt DESC
